plot: One afternoon in the kitchen the greedy vacuum Gulpzilla slurps up Bup; Lolly gets stuck to the hose and Pim's feed-him-a-watermelon plan fails because the bag stays flat, until Pim sees the loaf-shaped bump and realizes Bup is the cork jamming the hose, so the vacuum is starving because of Bup, Pim tickles him free, Gulpzilla is finally full, and he burps up a three-eyed 'Club Member #2' badge.

script.title: How Do We Get Bup Out of the Vacuum

beats.say: The vacuum ate Bup! How do we get him out?!
MINE! All mine! Slurrrp! Still... so... hungry!
Pim, breathe. Bup is in there. We are getting him back.
Hello? It's very dark in here. And it smells like socks!
He's okay! But listen. His voice comes from the hose.
Mister Gulpzilla, please. Give our friend back. Pretty please?
No! Hungry! Always... empty... inside!
He slurps a spoon, three crumbs, and one of Lolly's icing drips.
My. Icing. Drip.
Oh no. She's using the quiet voice. Everybody hide.
Look at his dust bag. It's flat. Totally empty.
Impossible. He eats everything, but nothing ever lands in the bag.
Maybe he's on a diet. A very rude diet.
Then where did Bup go? Where does everything go?
Guys? Stuff keeps flying at my face. A button just hit me!
Plan one. We go in after him. I go first.
In? Into the dust monster? I'll guard the snacks out here.
Lolly marches up to the hose. The hose breathes in.
I'm stuck to the hose! If I go in, nobody saves Bup!
Pulling! Pulling! Why are you so sticky?!
It's icing, Pim! Icing is extremely sticky! Pull harder!
Pop! They both fly backwards into the sugar bowl.
Plan one is cancelled. Forever. I have sugar in my points.
His hose is swelling! If it bursts, Bup flies out the window!
Did somebody say window? I do not want to visit the window!
Plan two! We feed him something huge, so he gets full!
Pim, that's actually smart. What's the biggest thing in here?
Crispy rolls in a whole watermelon. Nobody knows where he got it.
Don't ask.
A melon heavier than all of us. Okay. I won't ask.
MELON! MINE! Slurrrrrp!
Still... hungry! Why am I... always... hungry?!
Ow! A watermelon just squeezed past me! I'm a sandwich now!
The hose is shaking! One more bite and it explodes!
Wait. That bump in the hose. It's shaped like a loaf.
Bup isn't in the bag. He's stuck in the hose!
He's a cork! A loaf-shaped cork! Nothing can get past him!
So that's why the vacuum is starving. Poor, hungry thing.
I'm the cork? I'm the problem? Okay. That's embarrassing.
Tummy... so... empty... Help... me?
Oh. He isn't mean. He's just really, really hungry.
Pim, you're the smallest. Tickle the bump. Bup is super ticklish.
Me? Tickle a vacuum? Okay. For Bup. Tickle, tickle, tickle!
Ha! Hahaha! Stop! I'm slipping! I'm SLIPPING!
Bup shoots out. The melon, spoon and buttons rush into the bag.
FULL! Finally... full! Thank you... little bean!
Rule one, team. Never stand in front of a hungry hose.
Rule two. Nobody touches my icing. Ever.
Rule three. Pim is never the tickler again.
Gulpzilla burps. A shiny badge with three eyes lands at Bup's feet.
Member number two? Then who on earth is number one?

long.title: How Do We Get Bup Out of the Vacuum? 🌀
long.description: Gulpzilla the greedy vacuum just slurped up Bup, and his dust bag is somehow still empty. Lolly gets stuck, a watermelon disappears, and the hose starts to swell. Would YOU climb into the vacuum to save a friend? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy
